description: Create a Mango Inventory account in the user's name. Works without an account. Needs the user's name, email address and organization name; language, organization type and currency are optional. Mango Inventory sends ONE email to the address; its button confirms the address and signs the user in. The call returns no password, key or link. Once the address is confirmed, any account tool (for example get_setup_status) brings up the client's normal sign-in step (in Claude Code: /mcp), and after it every tool works. Until the button is pressed nothing can be done in the account, and an account that is never confirmed does nothing. The answer is the same whether or not the address already had an account; a refusal names its reason (invalid or disposable address, a domain that receives no mail, an invalid name, a rate limit). Idempotent: a repeat for the same address creates no second account. On a signed-in connection it answers signedIn and creates nothing.

currency.description: Their currency, if known: chf (default), eur, gbp or usd.

email.description: The user's email address, as given.

language.description: Their language for the email and the app: en (default), de, fr, it or es.

name.description: The user's name, as given. Up to 100 characters.

orgName.description: The organization's name, as given. Up to 100 characters.

orgType.description: The kind of organization, if known (as in check_fit).
